Nina Alvarez: Alert from OrionCloud: container OC-9921 diverted at port clearance. Estimated delay 5-9 days. Affects SKUs: RWD-GPU-4 x90, RWD-SSD-2TB x210.
Benji Cole: Oof. Which commitments hit?
Nina Alvarez: Dedicated commitments for cust-211, cust-333, cust-405. Shortfalls: -30, -20, -40 GPUs respectively.
Harper Liu: Quick inventory check: NA marketplace pool has 35 GPUs, APAC has 25. We can reassign some but still short ~30 GPUs.
Orion Bot: Partner notice: OC-9921 status -> diverted_for_inspection. Tracking: https://partners.orioncloud/track/OC-9921
Benji Cole: Options: 1) ask Orion for air-split for priority SKUs; 2) pull from marketplace pools + offer credits; 3) one-time spot buy. Prioritize RWD-GPU-4 for Dedicated workloads.
Nina Alvarez: Reached out to Orion rep (Marcel). He says customs may clear faster if we provide paperwork; estimating 3-5 days if we expedite.
Ravi Sundar: Finance ok with credits for impacted customers; need list + amounts. If we do spot buy, benchmark max unit price cap = $X,XXX.
Harper Liu: I'll prepare marketplace reassign plan and tag which customer reservations can be partially fulfilled.
Benji Cole: I'll coordinate with ops to enable oversubscribe and throttle non-critical jobs. Nina, keep pushing Orion for partial release.
Nina Alvarez: Will do. Action owners: Harper (reassign), Benji (ops), Ravi (credits). Updating thread when Orion confirms paperwork window. :white_check_mark:
